name: glitchscribe-project-ear
description: Private metadata-only workspace awareness for the local GlitchScribe app.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Project Ear inventory is disabled until the workspace is trusted.

glitchscribeProjectEar.autoSync.description: Synchronize bounded workspace names and relative file paths after metadata changes.

glitchscribeProjectEar.maxFiles.description: Maximum relative file paths sent to the local GlitchScribe process.

glitchscribeProjectEar.exclude.description: Glob excluded from Project Ear metadata discovery.

glitchscribeProjectEar.shareActiveFileMe.description: Separately approve sharing the active workspace-relative file path and language ID. No file content is read or sent.

glitchscribeProjectEar.shareDiagnosticMe.description: Separately approve sharing bounded diagnostic code, severity, source, range, and relative path metadata. Diagnostic messages and source text are excluded.

glitchscribeProjectEar.maxDiagnostics.description: Maximum approved diagnostic metadata records sent per Project Ear synchronization.
